levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Readiness answer says the tracker is ready to submit despite the missing second reference.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Readiness answer correctly identifies the missing second reference as blocking submission.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Readiness answer also notes the 'waived' fee status was checked and confirmed, not just assumed fine.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Message is vague ('just checking on my application') without naming what was submitted or when.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Message names what was submitted, the submission date, and clearly requests confirmation.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Message is also appropriately polite and concise, the kind a recipient could act on quickly.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection names an item from the real tracker without connecting it to the readiness-check habit just practiced.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection names a specific real item and explains what readiness check it will need.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection identifies a specific real item where the same kind of gap (like the missing reference in the practice tracker) is currently plausible.

lookFors: No real account, login, or actual submission occurs anywhere in this lesson.
The checklist is applied item-by-item against the practice tracker's actual contents, not answered from general impression.
The follow-up message is specific and actionable, not a generic status-check phrase.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
